yaml:
# Generated by tools/genpublicapi from api/openapi.yaml. Do not edit: go run ./tools/genpublicapi rewrites it, and a
# test fails when this file is not what that command writes.
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  description: |
    The public API of Ctrl Z: the operations an API token may call.

    Make a token in Preferences, API. A token is `read` or `write` for good, may be limited to some addresses, and lives 365 days. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer ctz_...`. A `read` token cannot call an operation that changes anything. A request that carries a session cookie as well is refused, and so is a token on an operation that is not in this document.

    Errors are `Error` bodies. A token that is not live is `401 token_invalid`; `403 token_read_only`, `403 token_ip_not_allowed`, `403 token_not_allowed` and `403 account_suspended` say why a live one was refused; `429 rate_limited` carries `Retry-After`.
  title: Ctrl Z public API
  version: 0.2.0-p1
servers:
  - description: Behind the Panel hostname, through the front door.
    url: /api/v1
tags:
  - description: The signed-in user's own account.
    name: account
  - description: Endpoints, their groups, schedules and clients.
    name: endpoints
  - description: Profiles, their documents, the lock, and the batch jobs.
    name: profiles
  - description: The options of a profile, the Default Rule among them.
    name: options
  - description: The catalog of filters and the filters a profile turns on.
    name: filters
  - description: The services a profile blocks, bypasses or redirects.
    name: services
  - description: The catalog of services and their categories.
    name: service-categories
  - description: The folders of a profile's custom rules and their export and upload.
    name: rule-folders
  - description: The custom rules of a profile.
    name: custom-rules
  - description: The locations a profile may use.
    name: locations
  - description: The addresses authorized to use an Endpoint.
    name: authorized-ips
paths:
  /account/limits:
    get:
      operationId: getLimits
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Limits'
          description: One number per quota.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: The quotas in force, read only
      tags:
        - account
      x-ctrlz-token: read
  /catalog/filters:
    get:
      description: |
        Names in both languages, the state of each filter and, for a filter with several modes, its modes in wire order
        with the default marked. A filter with one mode lists none. Enabling or changing the mode of New Domains is
        subject to the `.ir` warning of D45: the same sentence is in the filter's explanation.
      operationId: listCatalogFilters
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/CatalogFilterList'
          description: Every filter.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: The 20 Native and 12 3rd Party filters with their modes
      tags:
        - filters
      x-ctrlz-token: read
  /catalog/services:
    get:
      operationId: listCatalogServices
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/CatalogServiceList'
          description: Every category and service.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: The service categories and the services of the catalog
      tags:
        - service-categories
      x-ctrlz-token: read
  /catalog/timezones:
    get:
      description: The region zones of the Go time zone database the panel embeds, which the compiler resolves too.
      operationId: listTimezones
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/TimezoneList'
          description: The zones.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: The time zones a schedule may use
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: read
  /endpoint-groups:
    get:
      operationId: listEndpointGroups
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/GroupList'
          description: The groups, oldest first.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: The tenant's Endpoint groups
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: read
    post:
      description: 'Errors: `validation_failed` (`max_endpoint_groups` exceeded).'
      operationId: createEndpointGroup
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/GroupCreate'
        required: true
      responses:
        "201":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Group'
          description: The group.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Create a group, and move Endpoints into it
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoint-groups/{gid}:
    delete:
      operationId: deleteEndpointGroup
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/GroupId'
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Deleted.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Delete a group; its Endpoints stay, with no group
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: write
    patch:
      operationId: patchEndpointGroup
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/GroupId'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/GroupRename'
        required: true
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Group'
          description: The group.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Rename a group
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoint-types:
    get:
      operationId: listEndpointTypes
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/EndpointTypeList'
          description: The types.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: The 30 Endpoint types, in the order of the seed
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: read
  /endpoints:
    get:
      operationId: listEndpoints
      parameters:
        - in: query
          name: group
          required: false
          schema:
            format: uuid
            maxLength: 36
            pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$
            type: string
        - in: query
          name: type
          required: false
          schema:
            maxLength: 32
            minLength: 1
            pattern: ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$
            type: string
        - in: query
          name: status
          required: false
          schema:
            enum:
              - pending
              - active
            maxLength: 8
            type: string
        - description: A case-insensitive part of the name.
          in: query
          name: q
          required: false
          schema:
            maxLength: 64
            pattern: ^(?:[^\p{C}]|\p{Cf}|[\t\n\r])*$
            type: string
        - description: '`created` is newest first (the default); `name` is alphabetical.'
          in: query
          name: sort
          required: false
          schema:
            enum:
              - created
              - name
            maxLength: 8
            type: string
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ListCursor'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Limit'
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/EndpointPage'
          description: One page.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: The tenant's Endpoints, one page
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: read
    post:
      description: 'Errors: `validation_failed` (`max_endpoints` exceeded, a name, a profile), `destinations_lost`, `idempotency_key_reused`, `conflict`.'
      operationId: createEndpoints
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/EndpointCreate'
        required: true
      responses:
        "201":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/EndpointCreated'
          description: The Endpoints, in the order of the names.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Create one Endpoint per name
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoints/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: getEndpoint
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Endpoint'
          description: The Endpoint.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: One Endpoint
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: read
    patch:
      description: |
        Errors: `profile_locked`, `invalid_credentials`, `too_many_attempts`, `destinations_lost`, `validation_failed`
        (`needs_authorized_ip`, `same_profile`), `server_busy`.
      operationId: patchEndpoint
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/EndpointPatch'
        required: true
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Endpoint'
          description: The Endpoint.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Change an Endpoint
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoints/{id}/authorized-ips:
    get:
      description: '`is_current` marks the row that holds the address of this request: its delete is refused (spec 5 rule 1).'
      operationId: listAuthorizedIps
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
        - description: A part of the address, as text.
          in: query
          name: q
          required: false
          schema:
            maxLength: 64
            pattern: ^(?:[^\p{C}]|\p{Cf}|[\t\n\r])*$
            type: string
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Cursor'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Limit'
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthorizedPage'
          description: One page.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: The authorized addresses of an Endpoint, newest first
      tags:
        - authorized-ips
      x-ctrlz-token: read
    post:
      description: |
        IPv4 /16 or narrower, IPv6 /32 or narrower. Any refused prefix refuses the request, each named by its index in `cidrs`.
        Errors: `validation_failed` (`invalid`, `out_of_range`, `exists`, `duplicate`, `max_authorized_ips` exceeded).
      operationId: addAuthorizedIps
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthorizedAdd'
        required: true
      responses:
        "201":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthorizedAdded'
          description: The rows made.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Add up to 100 addresses or subnets
      tags:
        - authorized-ips
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoints/{id}/authorized-ips/{aid}:
    patch:
      description: 'Turning it on while the Endpoint requires authorized IPs needs the lock passwords. Errors: `profile_locked`, `invalid_credentials`, `too_many_attempts`, `server_busy`.'
      operationId: patchAuthorizedIp
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/AuthorizedId'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthorizedPatch'
        required: true
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthorizedIP'
          description: The row.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Opt a row in or out of the automatic cleanup
      tags:
        - authorized-ips
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoints/{id}/authorized-ips:delete:
    post:
      description: |
        All or none. The row that holds the address of the request, and the last row of an Endpoint that requires authorized IPs,
        are not deleted: `validation_failed` with `current_address` or `last_authorized` on the indexes of `ids`. While Require is
        on the lock passwords are needed: `profile_locked`, `invalid_credentials`, `too_many_attempts`, `server_busy`.
      operationId: deleteAuthorizedIps
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthorizedDelete'
        required: true
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Deleted.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Delete authorized addresses
      tags:
        - authorized-ips
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoints/{id}/clients:
    get:
      description: '`count` is how many clients match the filter, whatever the page.'
      operationId: listClients
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
        - in: query
          name: q
          required: false
          schema:
            maxLength: 64
            pattern: ^(?:[^\p{C}]|\p{Cf}|[\t\n\r])*$
            type: string
        - in: query
          name: group
          required: false
          schema:
            maxLength: 64
            minLength: 1
            pattern: ^[^\s\p{C}][^\p{C}]*$
            type: string
        - in: query
          name: inactive_days
          required: false
          schema:
            maximum: 3650
            minimum: 1
            type: integer
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Cursor'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Limit'
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ClientPage'
          description: One page.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: The clients of an Endpoint, newest first
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: read
    post:
      description: |
        The label is given or derived from the alias; `default` is the hub's own. Errors: `profile_locked`,
        `invalid_credentials`, `too_many_attempts`, `destinations_lost`, `validation_failed` (`exists`, `reserved`,
        `max_clients_per_endpoint` exceeded), `server_busy`.
      operationId: createClient
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ClientCreate'
        required: true
      responses:
        "201":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Client'
          description: The client.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Add a custom client
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoints/{id}/clients/{cid}:
    patch:
      description: |
        Errors: `profile_locked`, `invalid_credentials`, `too_many_attempts`, `destinations_lost`, `validation_failed`,
        `server_busy`.
      operationId: patchClient
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ClientId'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ClientPatch'
        required: true
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Client'
          description: The client.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Change a client
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoints/{id}/clients:batch:
    post:
      description: |
        Exactly one of `ids` and `selector`. A selector resolves at most 500 clients in the write; `more` says matches
        remain, so the caller repeats. Errors: as for a change of one client.
      operationId: batchClients
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ClientBatch'
        required: true
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ClientBatchResult'
          description: How many clients were changed, and whether matches remain.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Edit or delete clients by id or by a selector
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoints/{id}/ddns-hosts:
    get:
      operationId: listDdnsHosts
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/DdnsHostList'
          description: The hosts, oldest first.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: The Dynamic DNS hosts of an Endpoint
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: read
    post:
      description: |
        At most five an Endpoint. A host never proves an address (spec 4.5). Errors: `validation_failed` (`invalid`, `exceeded`,
        `exists` on `/hostname`, `max_ddns_hosts` exceeded).
      operationId: createDdnsHost
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/DdnsHostCreate'
        required: true
      responses:
        "201":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/DdnsHost'
          description: The host.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Add a Dynamic DNS host
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoints/{id}/ddns-hosts/{hid}:delete:
    post:
      description: |
        The rows the host learned go through the same rules as an authorized delete (spec 5). Errors: `validation_failed`
        (`current_address`, `last_authorized`), `profile_locked`, `invalid_credentials`, `too_many_attempts`, `server_busy`.
      operationId: deleteDdnsHost
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/DdnsHostId'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/LockPasswordsBody'
        required: true
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Deleted.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Delete a Dynamic DNS host and the addresses it learned
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoints/{id}/generators:
    get:
      description: |
        The output of one generator of the registry (P3 8.2) as `text/plain`: Windows commands, a Firefox or a Chromium policy, the
        Android Private DNS host, the addresses for a router or a TV. The text carries the DoH token. Errors: `not_found` for a
        generator that is not in the registry, `setup_unavailable` while no domain or no pair is set.
      operationId: getEndpointGenerator
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
        - description: The id of a generator of the registry, such as `windows-doh`, `firefox-policy`, `chromium-policy`, `android-private-dns` or `address-list`.
          in: query
          name: generator
          required: true
          schema:
            maxLength: 32
            minLength: 1
            pattern: ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$
            type: string
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ClientLabel'
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The text, as `text/plain`.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: One generated setup text
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: read
  /endpoints/{id}/resolvers:
    get:
      description: |
        The Resolver view of one Endpoint and, with `client`, of one of its clients (P3 8.1): the host, the DoH URL, the Legacy
        DNS addresses, the bootstrap addresses and the DNS Stamps. It carries the DoH token. While no domain or no pair is set
        `ready` is false and `reason` says which.
      operationId: getEndpointResolvers
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ClientLabel'
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ResolverView'
          description: The view.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: The values to set a device up with
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: read
  /endpoints/{id}/schedule:
    get:
      operationId: getEndpointSchedule
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Schedule'
          description: The zone and the windows, ordered by start.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: The schedule of an Endpoint
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: read
    put:
      description: |
        The windows are in minutes of the week, Sunday 00:00 being 0, in multiples of 30. Errors: `profile_locked`,
        `invalid_credentials`, `too_many_attempts`, `destinations_lost`, `validation_failed` (`grid`, `overlap`, `exceeded`),
        `server_busy`.
      operationId: putEndpointSchedule
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/SchedulePut'
        required: true
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Schedule'
          description: The schedule as stored.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Replace the schedule of an Endpoint
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoints/{id}:delete:
    post:
      description: 'Errors: `profile_locked`, `invalid_credentials`, `too_many_attempts`, `endpoint_held`, `server_busy`.'
      operationId: deleteEndpoint
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/LockPasswordsBody'
        required: true
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Deleted.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Delete an Endpoint
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoints/{id}:rotate-resolver:
    post:
      description: |
        Every device must be set up again and every share and download link of the Endpoint ends. Errors:
        `profile_locked`, `invalid_credentials`, `too_many_attempts`, `server_busy`.
      operationId: rotateEndpointResolver
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Id'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/LockPasswordsBody'
        required: true
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Endpoint'
          description: The Endpoint, with its new resolver id.
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security:
        - apiToken: []
      summary: Draw a new resolver id and DoH token
      tags:
        - endpoints
      x-ctrlz-token: write
  /endpoints/export:
    get:
      description: |
        `text/csv`, UTF-8 with a byte order mark. Columns: name, type, group, profile, profile 2, status, admin state,
        analytics, resolver id, host, Legacy DNS, last query (RFC 3339 UTC), created. Never the DoH token. A cell that
        starts with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, a tab or a carriage return gets a leading apostrophe.
      operationId: exportEndpoints
      responses:
        "200":
